headline.purpose: Page-level h1. Rare in this app.

label.purpose: Uppercase micro-labels: table headers, nav section titles.

data.purpose: Every amount, custody code, page number and calendar day. Tabular figures are the point.

shadows.name: shadow-xs
shadows.purpose: A card's slight separation from the canvas. The default for a resting surface.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: The login card and the active tab.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns, autocomplete lists, the date popover.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Modal panels and the mobile sidebar drawer.

shadows.name: shadow-focus
shadows.purpose: The focus ring, always paired with a border shift to petrol.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out. The only easing in the system.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Row hover and other high-frequency feedback.

motion.name: transition
motion.purpose: The default for state changes on controls.

motion.name: transition-slow
motion.purpose: The sidebar drawer. The ceiling: nothing here makes the operator wait longer.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Every primary action. Ink rather than accent, so the accent stays rare enough to mean orientation.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: #232019; color: #faf9f7; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; min-height: 38px; font: 600 0.82rem/1.4 Manrope, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: #3a352c; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0d5c53; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Cancel, close, and any action that sits beside a primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #44403a; border: 1px solid #d3d0c9; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; min-height: 38px; font: 600 0.82rem/1.4 Manrope, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f5f4f1; border-color: #b9b5ab; color: #1c1a17; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The focus treatment is a border shift plus a ring, never one alone.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #ffffff; color: #1c1a17; border: 1px solid #d3d0c9; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem; min-height: 44px; font: 400 0.93rem/1.6 Manrope, sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #b9b5ab; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0d5c53; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(13,92,83,0.22); }

components.name: Money Cell
components.description: The signature component. Right-aligned, monospaced, tabular — a column of these cannot shift under the eye between rows.
components.css: .ds-money-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; font: 500 0.82rem/1.6 Manrope, sans-serif; color: #1c1a17; } .ds-money-table td { padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #efedea; } .ds-money-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; } .ds-money { text-align: right; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-feature-settings: 'tnum' 1; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Squared, not lozenge-shaped: a pill on every row of a dense table is noise. Same meaning is always the same hue.
components.html: En mora Al día Próximo
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.16rem 0.45rem; font: 600 0.72rem/1.4 Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; border: 1px solid #e4e2dd; background: #f5f4f1; color: #44403a; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pill-overdue { background: #fdefed; color: #912018; border-color: #f2c9c4; } .ds-pill-current { background: #ecf5ee; color: #14602f; border-color: #bcdcc6; } .ds-pill-upcoming { background: #eaf1f8; color: #1a4d81; border-color: #c2d7ea; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Link
components.description: The active state is the one place the accent appears in the chrome: a 3px petrol rule answering 'where am I'.
components.html: ClientesPagosGarantías
components.css: .ds-nav { background: #1a1815; padding: 0.75rem; border-radius: 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.1rem; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; color: #cbc6ba; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 0.93rem/1.6 Manrope, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: #f5f4f1; } .ds-nav-active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.09); color: #f5f4f1; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; width: 3px; height: 1.1rem; border-radius: 0 999px 999px 0; background: #4ba599; transform: translateY(-50%); }

components.name: Card
components.description: A container, not a decoration. Flat at rest and it does not lift on hover, because it cannot be clicked.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e4e2dd; border-radius: 10px; padding: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(35,32,25,0.05); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.35rem; } .ds-card-label { margin: 0; color: #6b655c; font: 500 0.82rem/1.6 Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-card-value { margin: 0; color: #1c1a17; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.15; }

narrative.overview:
This is a tool held in someone's hands while a customer waits on the other side of the desk. It takes its character from the thing it replaced: a warm paper ledger, ruled in hairlines, written in a hand that stays legible after the hundredth entry. Not the vault, not the strongroom, not a fintech app — the book the amounts were kept in.

Everything follows from the fact that every number on these screens is money that belongs to somebody else. Figures are set in a monospaced face and aligned so a column of pesos cannot shift under the eye between rows. Colour is scarce enough that when it appears it means something: a status, a selection, a place. Surfaces are quiet so the figures on them are not. Motion reports that something changed and then gets out of the way.

The rejected world is specific and was the incumbent: the generic AI dashboard — indigo gradients on the sidebar and on every button, frosted panels, a decorative circle behind each stat tile, Inter everywhere. It looked like a product demo rather than a place of record, and some of it worked against the reading: proportional digits in money columns, a hover lift on cards that cannot be clicked, four competing background states in one table.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutrals throughout; no cool grey anywhere
Figures in a monospaced face with tabular alignment
One accent, spent only on orientation
Ink, not accent, for primary actions
Flat surfaces, hairline separation, shadows only where something genuinely floats
Density is correct; whitespace serves grouping, not spectacle

rules.name: The Orientation Rule
rules.body: Petrol answers exactly one question: where am I, and what is selected. It never fills a button, never tints a panel, never marks a status. If a use of the accent is not answering that question, it is decoration and belongs in ink or a neutral.

rules.name: The One Grey Family Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is warm. A cool grey anywhere — a #64748b, a #cbd5e1, an undefined token falling back to a Tailwind default — is a defect, not a variation. Three such fallbacks were live in this codebase.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number a reader compares against another number is set in --font-mono with tabular-nums. Money, custody codes, page numbers, calendar days, counts. A proportional digit in a money column is a defect, because it moves the thousands place between rows and the eye has to re-find it every time.

rules.name: The Right-Aligned Money Rule
rules.body: Amounts are right-aligned in tables. td.text-right gets tabular figures automatically, because in this app a right-aligned cell is always a figure.

rules.name: The No-Halo Rule
rules.body: A zero-offset glow is decoration, not depth. Every shadow here has an offset and a soft blur.

dos: Do set every figure a reader compares in --font-mono with tabular figures.
Do reach for a hairline and spacing before a fill, a border or a shadow.
Do spend --accent only on orientation: active nav, focus, selection, sort, links.
Do give every interactive element a default, hover, focus-visible, active and disabled state before shipping it.
Do name a step from the type scale. An ad-hoc font-size: 0.85rem in a scoped block is what flattened the rendered hierarchy.

Do put a new shared class in main.css. A class that exists only in markup styles nothing — .page-header-actions, .fw-bold, .text-warning-dark, .spinner-small, .mt-24 and .notice-info were all live examples.
donts: Don't introduce a cool grey, or a var(--some-token, #hardcoded) fallback for a token this system does not define. Three of those were shipping the old palette.
Don't use a gradient. Not on the sidebar, not on a button, not behind a stat tile.
Don't lift a card on hover, or scale a button toward the cursor.
Don't animate width, height, padding or margin. Transform and opacity.
Don't add a fourth background state to a table row.
Don't put a raw <select>, a raw money <input>, or a Unicode glyph standing in for an icon anywhere in views/ or components/.
Don't write an inline style attribute or an arbitrary z-index. The scale runs --z-sticky 8, --z-popover 40, --z-backdrop 90, --z-sidebar 100, --z-modal 200, --z-confirm 300, --z-dropdown 1000.
Don't ship a user-facing string that is not a vue-i18n key present in both locale blocks. npm run check:i18n enforces it.
